description.p: A small glass pill sits at the top of the screen. Hover it and it opens into a grid of tools; move away and it folds back.

ul.li: Timer and stopwatch, Coffee (keep awake), clipboard history, media controls
Text extractor (OCR), color picker, Google Lens search, font detector, screenshots
Draw on screen, QR codes, calculator, voice memos, notes, calendar
System monitor, wallpaper browser, file shelf, quick launch
Phone link: LocalSend file transfer, scrcpy mirroring, notifications
